verdict.rationale: Simular's materials consistently say the agent looks at the screen and acts on it by clicking, typing and scrolling (simular-gh-1). They also say it understands interfaces through the graphical interface rather than APIs (simular-docs-18) and controls computers through the UI like a human (simular-docs-4). Saved workflows consult the model 'where the screen matters' and self-heal when the UI changes, which implies actions are grounded on what is actually displayed (simular-docs-7, simular-docs-8). missing for 10: technical documentation of the screen-capture/vision pipeline and grounding mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration of perception accuracy.
